meta.name: caption-burn
meta.description: Burned-in captions for a finished vertical video, three kinds. transcribe.py gets word timings from the video's own audio through the GooseWorks proxy (fal Whisper, bills the Ads agent, cents); captions.py burns one to three words at a time with Pillow + ffmpeg (no libass needed), either pinned to a split-screen seam (plate 25% above / 75% below) or at a fixed height, in a plate, outline or one-word serif style, with an optional red hook card; plates.py burns per-beat caption blocks (black, one union silhouette, placed in the emptiest band) for formats with no voice. The last caption (the CTA) holds to the final frame. Use as the last step of any video ad.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给成片竖版视频烧上字幕,可按分屏接缝或固定高度排版,还能加红色钩子卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做竖版视频广告,想给已剪好的成片加上烧录字幕
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're finishing a vertical video ad and need burned-in captions.

howto.what: 给已完成的竖版视频烧录字幕:用视频自身音频取词级时间轴,再按节拍把 1~3 个词压进画面(可选红钩卡),无口播的视频则按节拍烧黑底字幕块;末条 CTA 字幕保留到最后一帧。
howto.when: 原文写明用在任何视频广告的最后一步:视频已剪完、要出带字幕的成片时接管,字幕时间以最终视频的音频为准,而不是脚本估算。

say.text: 用 outline 样式烧字幕,把品牌关键词标成黄色
say.note: 黄色出现在你指定的那个词上

say.text: 这段视频没人声,用 plates.py 按节拍打黑底字幕块
say.note: 节拍文件里要有 caption 文本

howto.what_en: Burns captions into a finished vertical video: timings come from the video's own audio, then captions are burned 1–3 words at a time (plate, outline or serif) with an optional red hook card; plates.py covers no-voice videos.
howto.when_en: Written as the last step of any video ad: it takes over once the video is finished and you want burned-in captions, reading the final audio for cues.

say_en.text: Burn captions onto reel.mp4 using cutlist.aligned.json and reel.words.json
Use the outline style and highlight the brand word in yellow
This clip has no voice — use plates.py to burn caption blocks per beat
say_en.note: The beats file needs caption text
